system.name: BGL
system.one_liner: a GPU-efficient GNN training system that optimizes graph data I/O and preprocessing

components.role: sampled subgraphs queued for worker 0's feature lookup

components.role: sampled subgraphs queued for worker 1's feature lookup

components.role: sampled subgraphs queued for worker 2's feature lookup

components.name: Dispatching Thread
components.role: dispatches each worker's subgraph feature queries into the shared cache query queue

components.name: Cache Query Queue
components.role: buffers feature queries between dispatching threads and processing threads

components.name: Processing Thread
components.role: processes cache queries, checking the GPU cache map and falling back to CPU cache or remote store on a miss

components.name: GPU Cache Map
components.role: per-GPU hashmap from node ID to buffer-slot pointer in that GPU's cache buffer

components.name: GPU Cache Buffer
components.role: stores cached node features in GPU memory; disjoint across GPUs and reachable from peers via NVLink P2P copy

components.name: CPU Cache Buffer
components.role: second-level, larger cache of node features in CPU memory

components.name: CPU Cache Map
components.role: hashmap for the CPU-level cache, using the same policy as the GPU cache

components.name: Remote Graph Store
components.role: fetched over the network on a cache miss at both GPU and CPU levels

flows.what: fallback lookup on GPU cache miss
fetch over the network on CPU cache miss

content.key_idea: BGL's feature cache engine uses per-GPU dispatch and processing threads around a shared query queue to look up cached node features first in GPU memory, then CPU memory, falling back to a remote graph store fetch only on a full cache miss.
content.reading_order: top-down and left-to-right, following circled steps 1 through 6: subgraphs enter per-worker dispatching threads, funnel into a shared cache query queue, are handled by per-GPU processing threads that check GPU then CPU cache maps, escalating to the remote graph store on a miss, with GPU cache buffers also linked peer-to-peer via NVLink.

summary: This figure details the internal structure and workflow of BGL's two-level feature cache engine inside a Worker Machine. Three parallel columns represent GPU workers 0-2: each has a Dispatching Thread that pushes subgraph feature queries into a shared Cache Query Queue, from which per-GPU Processing Threads pull requests. Each processing thread first checks its GPU Cache Map/Buffer; on a miss it falls back to the CPU Cache Buffer/Map, and on a further miss it fetches from a Remote Graph Store over the network. GPU Cache Buffers are also connected peer-to-peer via NVLink for direct feature transfer between GPUs. A top-left legend distinguishes NVLink, PCIe, and Network links by arrow color, and circled numbers 1-6 mark the ordered steps of a cache lookup.
summary_zh: 该图展示BGL特征缓存引擎的内部结构：三个GPU工作进程的调度线程将查询汇入共享缓存查询队列，处理线程依次查GPU缓存、CPU缓存，未命中则通过网络访问远程图存储，GPU间还可通过NVLink直接传输特征。
